messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@brightbyte.com>; BrightByte Finance <finance@brightbyte.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, May 3, 2027 at 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: Renewal runway signal review & action items (BrightByte)

Sarah / BrightByte team —

Quick note ahead of EOW: Finance asked we do a short runway / signal review for your upcoming renewal (target 2027-08-15). Attached is a clean copy of the renewal runway worksheet and a one-page commit summary. We pulled the current ARR, stage history, and open PO cadence into the sheet.

Top asks:
- Confirm committed ARR line items in tab "Customer Commit" by EOD Wed (5/5).
- If there are any holdbacks or conditional line items, flag them in column "risk_note" and add an expected resolution date.
- Naomi: please run the stress-case (Q3 worst-case churn) and paste the delta into the "Finance Stresstest" tab.

Initial notes from our side:
- Current committed ARR shown: $1.24M (annualized) — includes three pilots not yet invoiced.
- Stage drift seen on two seats: usage dropped in April; we flagged as "usage_watch".
- HubSpot deal RDW-2027-BB-1479 has been updated to reflect the new close plan (8/15).

Attachments: [Attachment: renewal_runway_Q3_v2.xlsx (52KB, spreadsheet)]

Proposed quick cadence: 15-min sync Thu 5/6 11:00 AM PT if there are open items after your review. If not, Naomi + Rishi will close the finance checklist and we’ll push for DocuSign.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@brightbyte.com>, BrightByte Finance <finance@brightbyte.com>
Date: Mon, May 3, 2027 at 11:03 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal runway signal review & action items (BrightByte)

Thanks Jonas — I pulled the latest telemetry and ran the Q3 stress-case as requested. Main takeaways (pulled into the attached short note):

- Base committed ARR: $1,240,000 (matches spreadsheet).
- Stress-case (20% immediate churn + 50% pilot conversion delay) => effective ARR: $980,000 (delta = -$260k).
- Biggest single risk is the east-coast pilot (Pilot: Ops Analytics, $180k annually) where usage dropped 60% in April.
- Two smaller line items show "payment_lag" patterns (Net 45 -> Net 60).

I flagged the pilot as "usage_high_risk" in column risk_note and added an expected resolution date of 2027-07-20 (internal target from CSM). I also added a note to the "Finance Stresstest" tab with the scenario assumptions.

Attachment: [Attachment: BrightByte_commit_notes.txt (4KB)]

If Sarah confirms the pilot is moving to full production or will be cancelled, we should update the runway immediately. Happy to join Thu if helpful.

-naomi
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Looping in quick stage update from my side after a 1:1 with the CSM this morning:

- CSM says the east-coast pilot is paused pending a compliance check (expected resolution 7/22). They asked for a smaller incremental plan (two-week spike) rather than cancellation.
- CSM confirmed that two smaller seats are on extended PO cycles but legal has signed the statements of work — billing can proceed once PO is received.

Action items I logged:
- Marissa: ask CSM to obtain a short note from customer legal confirming the PO timing (due 5/10).
- Jonas/Naomi: mark pilot as "conditional" in the spreadsheet and set expected conversion probability to 35% for the stress-case.

Thanks all for the thorough notes and the spreadsheet — super helpful. Quick clarifications from BrightByte:

- The east-coast pilot is not cancelled; compliance is the blocker. We expect a compliance sign-off by 7/20 and will prioritize if that lands earlier. For now we can accept marking it "conditional" with a 35% conversion probability.
- Finance confirmed two delayed POs — they will route them this week but anticipate Net-60.
- Please go ahead and send DocuSign for the licensed seats that are already approved (everything marked "approved_billing" in the sheet). We will sign once the PO numbers are attached.

Sarah
